pack: Combat VFX textures and ruin kit (B3)
command: python3 -I tools/art/fx_textures.py godot/assets/fx && python3 tools/art/fx_ruin_kit.py godot/assets/fx/ruin_kit.glb
method: textures: seeded numpy value-noise / fbm, gaussian blobs and analytic shapes (seed 20261023), PNG RGBA; ruin kit: code-built meshes with the Blender 5.2 Python module (bpy + bmesh): jagged wall-stub profiles, extruded fractured slabs, swept I-beam, displaced icosphere mounds, convex-hull blocks, cylinder rebar; GLB export, no embedded textures
tools: numpy, Pillow, Blender 5.2 (bpy module) - no AI image generation, no external textures, scans or photos
runtime: godot/scripts/fx.gd, fx_director.gd, fx_ruin.gd; textures imported lossless with mipmaps

items.description: 4x4 atlas of 16 grey smoke puffs with baked top light; random cell per particle, tinted by the colour ramp
4x4 atlas of 16 wispy dust puffs (ground dust, dust rings, collapse cloud)
4x4 flipbook: fireball breaking up into flame tongues over 16 frames (additive)
blast scorch decal: soot centre, radial streaks, ragged edge
ground decal under a ruin: ash, soot and grit, ragged rectangular edge
tileable greyscale concrete / plaster detail, tri-planar on ruin pieces and debris (tinted per building)
noisy dust / shock ring for huge blasts

ruin pieces: wall_a/b/c (4 m jagged wall stubs with rebar), corner_a, slab_a/b (fallen roof slabs with fractured edge and rebar grid), beam_a (bent I-beam), column_a (snapped column), mound_a/b (rubble heaps), chunk_a-d (blocks); materials RuinConcrete (tinted in game) and RuinRebar
